name: Alibaba Group Holding Limited
one_line_reason: The stock is down 55% because Alibaba is spending heavily on AI cloud capacity and a quick-commerce subsidy war, and free cash flow has turned sharply negative; the screen's 'cheap' cash-flow figure is last year's.
evidence: The September 2026 quarter 6-K (filed 2026-11-19) shows operating income of RMB29.1B (+443%) as quick-commerce losses shrank, cloud margin at 14.5% and cloud growth at a multi-quarter high. But free cash flow was an outflow of RMB34.5B in the quarter and RMB79.1B for the six months (vs RMB40.7B outflow a year earlier), because capex was RMB50.5B in the quarter (+60%) on AI infrastructure. Core Taobao customer-management revenue fell 5% (+1% like-for-like), so the profit recovery is subsidy cuts, not growth. The screen's $11.05B FCF is fiscal year to March 2026 and is already out of date.
key_numbers: Price $84.37, mcap $209.9B; FCF 6M to Sep-26 about -RMB79B (about -$11.8B); Q2 capex RMB50.5B (+60%); CMR -5%; screen P/E 14 and 10y-median 198 are not meaningful (FY25 NI inflated by investment gains)

key_numbers: P/E 36 trailing vs 81 10y median; fwd P/E about 27; EV/EBIT 24 vs 38; op margin 6.3% (Q3-26) vs about 10% (Q3-25); -46% from 3y high; revenue +45%
